translations.web: “Why do the wicked live, become old, yes, and grow mighty in power?
translations.bsb: Why do the wicked live on, growing old and increasing in power?
translations.kjv: Wherefore do the wicked live, become old, yea, are mighty in power?
translations.asv: Wherefore do the wicked live, Become old, yea, wax mighty in power?
